summary: Synchrony Financial filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of $1.1 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes, consisting of $600 million 5.450% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2030 and $500 million 6.276% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2037. The notes pay fixed interest initially then float over Compounded SOFR plus a spread, are senior unsecured, and are not listed. J.P. Morgan, TD Securities, and Wells Fargo are joint book-running managers. Use of proceeds is not stated in the excerpt. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
